finlan.translation: abbr. Finlandia (Portuguese=Finland) （葡萄牙语）芬兰; Finlndia (Italian or Spanish=Finland) （意大利语或西班牙语）芬兰

finland.definition: n. republic in northern Europe; achieved independence from Russia in 1917

finlander.definition: n. A native or inhabitant of Finland.

finlandization.translation: n. 芬兰化(指非共产党国家采取亲苏政策)

finlaya.translation: [医] 蚊亚属(伊蚊的一亚属,传染黄热病)

finlet.definition: n. A little fin; one of the parts of a divided fin.
